title: Enabling both basic auth and form auth in quarkus does not work
body:
**Description**
I tried enabling both basic and form authentication in quarkus 1.2.1.Final. According to the [documentation](https://quarkus.io/guides/all-config#quarkus-vertx-http_quarkus.http.auth.basic) when enabling both form and basic auth, basic auth should work in silent mode. As far as i understand this means that basic auth is used when an authorization header is sent.

**Expected behavior**
When enabling both form and basic auth and sending a GET request with valid Authorization header to a rest endpoint, basic auth should be used, the user should be authenticated successfully and the rest resource should be called.

**Actual behavior**
The request is forwarded to the form login page (default=login.html). It does not matter whether Authorization header is set and if credentials are valid. Form authentication will always be used instead of basic auth. When I disable form authentication and only enable basic auth, then basic auth works as expected.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Start with the code.quarkus.io project setup enabling "Properties File based Security"
2. Add to the application.properties file:
```application.properties
quarkus.http.auth.form.enabled=true
quarkus.http.auth.basic=true

quarkus.security.users.file.enabled=true
quarkus.security.users.file.users=test-users.properties
quarkus.security.users.file.roles=test-roles.properties
quarkus.security.users.file.realm-name=MyRealm
quarkus.security.users.file.plain-text=true
```
Add test-users.properties with content:
```test-users.properties
admin=admin
```

and test-roles.properties with content:
```test-roles.properties
admin=adminrole
```

3. Add annotation @RolesAllowed("adminrole") to the example rest resource at /hello
4. Send a GET request to /hello with Authorization header for user admin, password admin and observe that you get a 302 response instead of a 200.

**Environment:**
 - Output of `uname -a` or `ver`: Linux N302 5.3.0-40-generic #32-Ubuntu SMP Fri Jan 31 20:24:34 UTC 2020 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux
 - Output of `java -version`: openjdk version "1.8.0_242"
OpenJDK Runtime Environment (build 1.8.0_242-8u242-b08-0ubuntu3~19.10-b08)
OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM (build 25.242-b08, mixed mode)
 - GraalVM version (if different from Java): 
 - Quarkus version or git rev: 1.2.1.Final
